title: 🔥 GOD LOVES THE SINNER, BUT HE HATES THE SIN! – THE TRUTH EXPLAINED 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GOD LOVES THE SINNER, BUT HE HATES THE SIN! – THE TRUTH EXPLAINED 🔥
📖 Romans 5:8 – "But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I often hear people say, ‘God loves me just as I am,’ but I also hear others say, ‘God hates sin and will judge sinners.’ Which one is true? Does God love the sinner but hate the sin?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people today either abuse God’s love or misunderstand His holiness. Some believe they can continue living in sin because "God loves them," while others think God only wants to punish sinners.
🚨 It’s time to expose the lies and stand on BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. YES, GOD LOVES THE SINNER!
📖 John 3:16 – "For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."
🔥 God’s love is unconditional—but that doesn’t mean He approves of sin!

✔️ Jesus came to save sinners, not condemn them (Luke 19:10).
✔️ God’s love reaches the worst of sinners—no one is too far gone (1 Timothy 1:15).
✔️ Salvation is a gift, not something we earn (Ephesians 2:8-9).
💡 No matter how deep someone is in sin, God’s love is still calling them to repentance.
🚨 But here’s what most people ignore—God’s love does NOT mean He will tolerate sin!

🔥 2. BUT GOD HATES SIN – HE CANNOT IGNORE IT!
📖 Psalm 5:4 – "For You are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with You, evil people are not welcome."
🔥 God’s love does NOT cancel His holiness. He cannot accept sin!

✔️ God’s holiness demands justice (Habakkuk 1:13).
✔️ Sin separates us from God (Isaiah 59:2).
✔️ Unrepented sin leads to eternal destruction (Romans 6:23).
💡 God’s love offers salvation, but His justice demands judgment.
🚨 Many people today twist God’s love to justify their sin. Let’s expose these lies!

🔥 3. THE BIGGEST LIES ABOUT GOD'S LOVE – DEBUNKED!
📖 Isaiah 5:20 – "Woe to those who call evil good and good evil!"
🔥 Many false teachings have spread about God's love. Let’s expose them!

❌ LIE #1: "God loves me, so He won’t judge me."
✔️ TRUTH: God’s love provided a way of escape, but judgment still comes for those who reject Him (Hebrews 9:27).

❌ LIE #2: "Jesus loves everyone, so it doesn’t matter how we live."
✔️ TRUTH: Jesus told sinners to "go and sin no more" (John 8:11). True love leads to repentance!

❌ LIE #3: "We’re all sinners, so God understands if we continue in sin."
✔️ TRUTH: Yes, we all sin, but a true believer will not live in willful rebellion (1 John 3:9).
🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU TO BELIEVE IN A FALSE ‘LOVE’ THAT HAS NO HOLINESS!

🔥 4. TRUE LOVE CALLS FOR REPENTANCE!
📖 Romans 2:4 – "Do you not realize that God’s kindness is intended to lead you to repentance?"
🔥 God’s love does NOT leave us in sin—it calls us out of sin!

✔️ Jesus dined with sinners, but He never condoned their sin.
✔️ True love warns people about sin’s consequences.
✔️ If you truly love God, you will turn away from sin (John 14:15).
💡 Imagine a doctor who tells a dying patient, ‘You’re fine, don’t worry!’ That’s NOT love. True love warns of danger and provides a cure—this is what Jesus did!
🚨 If a "Christian" never speaks against sin, they are preaching a FALSE GOSPEL!

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – FROM SIN TO FREEDOM!
A young man lived a life of sin, thinking, "God loves me, so I can do whatever I want." He attended church, but his heart was unchanged.
🔥 One day, he read Hebrews 10:26 – "If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
🚨 He realized that he was deceived—he was abusing God’s grace! He repented, turned from his sinful lifestyle, and is now living for Jesus!
💡 TRUE LOVE leads to transformation, not complacency!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DO NOT ABUSE GOD’S LOVE!
📖 Galatians 6:7 – "Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows."
🚨 Many will miss heaven because they believed a FALSE version of God’s love!

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU DO?
❌ Believe in a soft, powerless "love" that tolerates sin?
✔️ Embrace TRUE love that calls for repentance and holiness?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER OF TRUE REPENTANCE
"Heavenly Father, thank You for loving me even in my sin. I repent and turn away from anything that separates me from You. Help me to live in obedience and walk in true love—not a love that tolerates sin, but a love that transforms! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
